item: Keyword list files split at 200 KB; R757 and R758 in RULINGS_INDEX (row 212)
summary: The All keywords export is handed back by the user through the same channel as the Diagnostics set, so the user's 2026-11-15 rule (every file sent back at most 200 KB) applies: UPLOAD_PART_BYTES 4,000,000 -> 200,000, equal to DIAG_PART_BYTES. Naming part-NN-of-MM and the manifest unchanged; no env override for the keyword set. A summary.json over one part goes out as summary.sNNN.json pieces that rejoin with join_json_pieces (existing writer behaviour). Hover title x12, user manual and page fallback say 200 KB. RULINGS_INDEX gains R757 (amended, defers to R466; PR #2182) and R758 (engine id POSIX-canonical, legacy id read never written; PR #2180). Release line: Keyword list files are now split at 200 KB each, named part N of M, like the Diagnostics files.
